Patch Set 1:

(4 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Mostly good, comments inline. The direction is right: the three sibling repair helpers (lfsck_layout_repair_unmatched_pair(), lfsck_layout_repair_owner(), lfsck_layout_repair_encflag()) all already use `GOTO(unlock, rc = 1)` for the dead-object case, so this brings __lfsck_layout_repair_dangling() back in line with them. One more no-op path in the same function looks like it was missed, and there is a pre-existing buffer mix-up a few lines below one of the changed lines.

commit.subject: LU-17891 lfsck: fix dangling object repair handling
commit.message:
LU-17891 lfsck: fix dangling object repair handling

Change the `GOTO(unlock2, rc = 0)` returns to use `rc = 1` instead.
This return value is reversed in lfsck_layout_trans_stop(), so using
`1` means nothing was repaired and it will return `0` to the caller
and avoid logging "Create the lost OST-object as required" and
counting this object being repaired when nothing was done.

Found during code review of another patch.
